name: atk-player
description: Cross-platform animation playback and review application
$comment: Qt is NOT a vcpkg dependency. Building Qt from source through vcpkg takes
hours on Windows and reproduces what the official binaries already provide.
Qt is installed separately and found through QT_ROOT -- see docs/BUILDING.md.
swscale            -- pixel format conversion to a viewer-ready RGB frame
swresample         -- audio conversion to a device-compatible PCM format

avdevice           -- provides the 'lavfi' input device, which is how the
                        deterministic test fixtures are generated. Not used by
                        the application itself.
  ffmpeg, ffprobe    -- command-line tools, used to generate and validate the
deterministic test fixtures the integration tests
decode. Not shipped with the application.
default-features is false on purpose: the port would otherwise also build
avdevice and avfilter, which ATK Player does not use.
GPL and nonfree features (gpl, all-gpl, nonfree, all-nonfree, x264, x265,
fdk-aac) are deliberately NOT enabled. ATK Player relies on FFmpeg's
built-in LGPL decoders. See docs/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md before changing
builtin-baseline pins the dependency graph so the build is reproducible.
